text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, April 7 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel loading, 6 due by 28/4, no delays.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 11 due by 20/4, no delays.

Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 6 waiting, 11 due by 20/4, 7 days delay expected. Maintenance shutdown commencing 07.00 hrs. 15/4. Berth closed for 88 hours, after which will open 23.00 hrs. 18/4.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 2 Vessels loading, 23 due 17/5, 1 days delay expected from 13/4.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 2 due by 24/4, no delays.
Brisbane - Five vessels due by 10/5, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Port closed at 11.15 hrs. 7/4 due to strong winds and heavy swell. Next inspection 07.00 hrs. 8/4.
Kooragang - No.4 terminal out of action for repairs for 24 hours from 02.00 hrs. 7/4. Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 13 due by 26/4, 2 days delay expected.
Dykes 4+5 - 2 Vessels loading, 9 waiting, 11 vessels due by 19/4, 8 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 20 due by 27/6, no delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to current shortage of Mt. Newman and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn. Vessels loading up ore may also experience some delays/slower loading rates due to heavy demand. (Only one vessel can be loaded with lump ore at a time.) Conveyor maintenance scheduled for 14/4, but only expected to cause minor delays. A berth - 3 Vessels anchored, 4 due by 13/4. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 3 due by 15/4, 7 others due by 23/4, no eta received.

Goldsworthy, Finucane island - Some delays can be expected due to shortage of Fines iron ore and maintenance difficulties. One vessel loading, 1 anchored, 3 due by 13/4, 1 due by 19/4, no eta received.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 3 vessels due by 9/4.
East Intercourse island - 4 Vessels due by 13/4.
Dampier line-up - 12 Vessels due by 20/4 of which 7 for Parker Point, 4 for East Intercourse island, 1 for Parker Point, East Intercourse island.
Port Walcott - Eight vessels due by 18/4.
April 9 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 3 due by 20/4, all to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 8 vessels due by 28/4, all to load wheat.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected.
Port Kembla - 16 Vessels due by May of which 14 to load wheat, 2 canola.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Two vessels waiting to load of which 1 wheat, 1 barley, 4 due by 22/4, all to load wheat.
Portland - One vessel loading wood-chips, 2 waiting to load of which 1 wheat, 1 canola. 9 Vessels due by 28/4 of which 4 to load wheat, 2 peas, 3 barley.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - One vessel loading wheat, 2 vessels due by 10/4 of which 1 to load wheat, 1 wheat/barley.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat/barley/beans, 3 due by 19/4, all to load wheat.
Thevenard, Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port lincoln - Five vessels due by 31/4 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 lupins.
Wallao - One vessel due 23/4 to load wheat.
Port Giles - One vessel due 16/4 to load wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - One vessel loading wheat, 5 anchored of which 3 to load wheat, 1 feed, 1 lupins. 5 Vessels due by 25/4, all to load wheat.
Kwinana - Three vessels loading (1 wheat, 1 barley, 1 lupins), 3 waiting to load wheat. 15 Vessels due by 27/4, all to load wheat.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 5 waiting of which 2 to load barley, 3 wheat, 1 due 25/4 to load wheat.
Esperance - One vessel loading wheat, 2 due by 20/4 of which 1 to load canola, 1 lupins.
